liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Bobby explains wooden teeth** (2 reviews): When Bobby says Washington's teeth were wooden, Pigpen shouts that they were hippo teeth; Early on Pigpen calls for Bob to talk, and Bob completely fumbles it [8][11]
- **Casey Jones** (1 review): Opening song has crystal-clear harmonies, showing the band was focused [10]
- **China Cat Sunflower** (1 other source): Cumberland Blues flows into China Cat Sunflower, which flows into I Know You Rider [2]
- **Turn On Your Lovelight** (1 review): The Lovelight is called epic [10]

## Setlist highlights

- **Bobby explains wooden teeth**: earliest performance in the archive; legendary: the only archived performance [16]
- Earliest performances in the archive: Cumberland Blues [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1969-11-15.sbd.tiedrich.9137.shnf** (recommended): soundboard; 18 songs; 120 min; rated 3.8/5 by 5 [1]. Said about its sound: Warm, deep, reasonably clear soundboard; vocals aren't overly prominent, and a scooped EQ suits it [10]
- **gd69-11-15.sbd.tiedrich.9535.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 120 min; rated 2.75/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: The recording is very quiet, though it represents the show well; Good sound for a 1969 recording, though not flawless; Sound is muddy with many feedback problems, and the show is fairly sloppy [5][6][8]
- **gd1969-11-15.sbd.tiedrich.fixed-9535.9538.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 120 min [3]
- **gd1969-11-15.141256.sbd.tiedrich.miller.clugston.pitch.corrected.flac1644**: soundboard; 17 songs; 122 min [4]

## Around the show

- Set in late 1969 context: Nixon in office, Vietnam protests growing, and the Dead playing Crockett, CA for a growing audience [7]
- Played at a small, very old converted movie theater near Richmond in the East Bay; possibly their only show there [11]
- Power is lost during the show, and the cause isn't a curfew [11]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1969-11-15.sbd.tiedrich.9137.shnf**: transferred by Jeff Tiedrich; source: SBD Cassette master > PCM > CDR [1]
- **gd69-11-15.sbd.tiedrich.9535.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Nathan Scott and Jeff Tiedrich; source: Soundboard [2]. Also: Soundboard cassette master transferred to PCM, then CDR, then iMac, then SHN; Nathan Scott supplied a shntool-fixed version, fixed disc by disc; a whole-set fix with slight differences also circulates [2]
- **gd1969-11-15.sbd.tiedrich.fixed-9535.9538.sbeok.shnf**: transferred by Jeff Tiedrich; source: Sound Board [3]
- **gd1969-11-15.141256.sbd.tiedrich.miller.clugston.pitch.corrected.flac1644**: taped by Jeff Tiedrich; transferred by Scott Clugston and Charlie Miller; source: Source Info: Master Soundboard Cassette > PCM > CDR > iMac > SHN; Transfer Info: SHN's > TLH > flac16 > Samplitude (16/44 .wav)> Adobe Audition 3.0 (16/44… [4]
